info.title: ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs
info.description: API Reference Guide for the ZIA Cloud Service and Sandbox Submission APIs

get.description: Retrieves information about the Remote Assistance option configured in the ZIA Admin Portal. Using this option, you can allow Zscaler Support to access your organization’s ZIA Admin Portal for a specified time period to troubleshoot issues. To learn more, see Enabling Remote Assistance.

put.description: Retrieves information about the Remote Assistance option configured in the ZIA Admin Portal. Using this option, you can allow Zscaler Support to access your organization’s ZIA Admin Portal for a specified time period to troubleshoot issues. To learn more, see Enabling Remote Assistance.

viewOnlyUntil.description: The time until when view-only access is granted. Unix time is used.

fullAccessUntil.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the user names for single sign-on users should be obfuscated or visible

usernameObfuscated.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the user names for single sign-on users should be obfuscated or visible

deviceInfoObfuscate.description: A Boolean value that indicates whether the device information (Device Hostname, Device Name, and Device Owner) should be obfuscated or visible on the Dashboard and Analytics pages
